### Apa yang pakej ini boleh dan tidak boleh tanya

[OPEN SOURCE ISSUE]

DOCX modul disimpan di luar repositori ini melalui identiti (16,832,861 bait, SHA-256 5a9142cdfa1a8090…). Tiada unit dalam kelompok ini mempunyai kandungan, visual atau sumber kuiz yang diekstrak.

| Syarat henti | Keadaan | Daftar |
|---|---|---|
| STOP-003 | VISUAL_INVENTORY_NOT_EXTRACTED | PL06_OPEN_AUTHORITY_ITEMS_v1 |
| STOP-004 | CONTROLLED_CONTENT_NOT_EXTRACTED | PL06_OPEN_AUTHORITY_ITEMS_v1 |
| STOP-005 | NO_QUIZ_SOURCE | PL06_OPEN_AUTHORITY_ITEMS_v1 |
| STOP-006 | CAST_BINDING_UNRESOLVED | PL06_OPEN_AUTHORITY_ITEMS_v1 |

> Oleh itu setiap kad diisi sepenuhnya di mana bukti beku sampai — sempadan, risiko muka surat dikongsi, pengumpulan pada aras tajuk, aritmetik bilangan skrin, perbendaharaan rawatan, guna semula — dan merekodkan PENDING_EXTRACTION di mana ia tidak sampai. Tiada batang soalan kuiz, hasil pembelajaran atau subjek visual ditulis untuk unit yang teksnya belum dibaca sesiapa.

### Yang mesti dilihat sebelum apa-apa kelulusan

**EX-01 · Screen-count arithmetic**

Every unit's screen count is given as a floor with its terms shown, never as a single number. Floors: K5-PL06-T03-B03 ≥ 6; K5-PL06-T03-B04 ≥ 6; K5-PL06-T05-B01 ≥ 10; K5-PL06-T06-B01 ≥ 8. Ceilings are UNKNOWN_PENDING_EXTRACTION.

**EX-02 · Proposal origin**

Every line carries one of five visible provenance labels. Nothing marked CAIR PROPOSAL has any evidence behind it beyond a heading.

**EX-03 · Source limitations**

The module DOCX is held externally by identity and is not in this repository. No unit in this batch has extracted content, visuals or quiz source. STOP-003, STOP-004 and STOP-005 are open on all four.

**EX-04 · Shared-boundary uncertainty**

T03-B03 shares both its start and end pages; T03-B04 shares its start. Those boundaries must be split by heading anchor. T05-B01 and T06-B01 have clean boundaries on both sides.

**EX-05 · Visual reuse restrictions**

No visual subject is proposed for any unit. T04's 46 obligations and 8 asset groups do not travel (NR-05, NR-06), and RP-104 forbids composing a subject from a component name.

**EX-06 · Answer keys not authority-approved**

No answer key exists for any unit in this batch. The status is NOT_DRAFTED, which is weaker than PENDING_APPROVAL: there is nothing to approve.

**EX-07 · Anticipated interaction-state complexity**

Base states follow the screen floor. Triggered and total runtime states are UNKNOWN_PENDING_EXTRACTION for every unit. T04's 65 states are not carried over.

## B. Peraturan seluruh kursus yang boleh diguna semula

[AUTO-APPLIED COURSE RULE]

Digunakan tanpa bertanya, kerana peraturan ini seluruh kursus atau generik — bukan keputusan instruksi khusus T04.

| ID | Peraturan | Skop | Bukti |
|---|---|---|---|
| AR-01 | Quiz composition: 4 Multiple Choice + 1 Multiple Response. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | Course-wide rule carried forward from the B02 Style and Guidelines (RP-009) and applied in T04. |
| AR-02 | Pass threshold: 60 percent. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | RP-010, same Style and Guidelines source as AR-01. |
| AR-03 | No learner-facing 'dalam modul', 'mengikut modul' or 'modul menyenaraikan'. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | Generic learner-language rule. A learner is reading the course, not being told about a document. |
| AR-04 | Multiple Response items use checkboxes with no A/B/C option labels. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | Generic assessment-mechanics rule; applied to T04 Q5. |
| AR-05 | Instructional clarity overrides production optimisation. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | Standing principle. Where a cheaper treatment would obscure the instruction, the clearer treatment wins. |
| AR-06 | Supported treatment vocabulary: static content, click-to-reveal, progressive process, comparison, scenario/dialogue only where justified. | ALL_PL06_UNITS | The vocabulary these units may be described in. A treatment outside it is an escalation, not a proposal. |

**Amaran yang tidak digugurkan senyap:**

- AR-01 — RP-009 classifies this GLOBAL on the strength of a Style and Guidelines document that is itself the B02 slice, and flags it human_authority_required = VERIFY. It is applied here as instructed and the flag is reported, not quietly dropped.
- AR-02 — Same VERIFY flag as AR-01.
- AR-03 — None. This is a phrasing rule, not an instructional decision.
- AR-06 — 'Only where justified' is doing real work in the last item: a dialogue needs a reason, not a habit.
Frasa yang tidak boleh muncul di hadapan pelajar: “dalam modul”, “mengikut modul”, “modul menyenaraikan” (AR-03).

## G. Pengecualian merentas unit

**XU-01 · B02 execution families**

Unit: K5-PL06-T03-B03, K5-PL06-T03-B04

Both units sit in Topik 3, B02's own Topik. RP-201 to RP-203 are readings of B02's table structure, not a PL06 taxonomy, and proximity is the reason they are most likely to be assumed here.

**XU-02 · Shared module page 255**

Unit: K5-PL06-T03-B03, K5-PL06-T03-B04

Module page 255 carries the end of T03-B03 and the start of T03-B04. Whichever unit is extracted first must stop at the named heading, not at the page break.

**XU-03 · Character cast**

Unit: K5-PL06-T03-B03, K5-PL06-T03-B04, K5-PL06-T05-B01, K5-PL06-T06-B01

STOP-006 is open. T05-B01 is the only unit proposing a dialogue, so it is the only one this immediately blocks — but any PINDA that adds a dialogue elsewhere inherits the same block.

**XU-04 · Boundary image custody**

Unit: K5-PL06-T03-B03, K5-PL06-T03-B04, K5-PL06-T05-B01, K5-PL06-T06-B01

Only T05-B01's start page image (p302) is ingested in this repository and was visually checked. T03-B03 (p268) and T06-B01 (p312) are named in the freeze package by identity only. T03-B04's start PDF page 273 has no image of its own in the package at all.

**XU-05 · Stale unit lists on the open-items register**

Unit: K5-PL06-T04-B01

STOP-003, STOP-004 and STOP-005 still list K5-PL06-T04-B01, which has since been extracted. The register is a historical run artifact and is not rewritten here; the divergence is recorded instead.
